title: Repeated work-tape head movement
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, and choose a work tape $h$. For any direction flag $neg$, blank flag $bl$, and natural number $a$, applying the selector-directed step $a$ times leaves every component of $c$ unchanged except the head position on tape $h$, which becomes its original position plus $a$ when $neg$ is false and minus $a$ when $neg$ is true.
